tools.name: search_fine_art_prints
tools.description: Searches curated fine art photographic prints by mood, landscape subject, room vibe, or wall color harmony. Use when exploring or comparing print candidates before mounting one.

query.description: Natural-language subject, mood, lighting, or color palette keywords

page.description: Page number starting at 1 (6 items per page)

tools.name: stage_artwork_in_room
tools.description: Mounts a fine art print into the 1:10 architectural room visualizer and configures room silhouette, wall paint, print dimensions, substrate, framing, or fulfillment. Use when staging or customizing a print on the wall.

artwork_id.description: Identifier of the print to mount (from search results)

paint_code.description: Pacific Northwest Rodda or Miller wall paint code

size.description: Uncropped 300 DPI print dimensions in inches

framing.description: Framing moulding or edge-lit halo option

fulfillment.description: Delivery or local partner pickup option

tools.name: curate_room_with_ai
tools.description: Analyzes a natural-language interior design brief and budget to recommend and automatically stage a harmonious print, wall paint, substrate, and framing spec. Use when the user describes their room, lighting, or budget.

design_brief.description: User description of their room, wall color, mood, lighting, or target budget

tools.name: initiate_paypal_checkout
tools.description: Prepares an itemized PayPal Orders v2 checkout ledger for the staged artwork and focuses the PayPal confirmation controls so the buyer can review and approve payment. Use when the user is ready to purchase.

buyer_note.description: Optional gift dedication or framing note to attach to the order summary
